agents.title: Social Media Manager
agents.summary: Does the whole job of an experienced social media manager: researches you, your competitors and your audience, sets the strategy and your voice, plans the calendar, then makes the posts and reel scripts.
gets: Research of you, 3 to 5 competitors and your audience, with sources
Strategy: goals, positioning, brand and content voice, content pillars
A dated content calendar and a posting routine
The first weeks of posts: images, captions, hashtags
Ready-to-shoot reel scripts: three hooks each, shot list, caption, keywords
A designed strategy report (web page and PDF)
needs: Your business, once (kept for every agent)
Your goal, platforms and time per week
Real facts: prices, offers, dates, follower counts

brief.label: What should social media do for you in this period?
options: More visits to the shop or site

brief.label: How much time can you or your team give each week?
Launches, offers, events or dates coming up
brief.hint: For example: summer sale 1 to 15 June, 20% off; new branch opens 3 July

brief.label: Anything else the manager should know
brief.hint: What has worked or not before, topics to avoid, people who can appear on camera

agents.prompt: Be my Social Media Manager. Use the mangoman-social-media-manager skill, with mangoman-market-research, mangoman-brand-strategy, mangoman-content-strategy, mangoman-copywriting, mangoman-strategy-report, mangoman-social-posts and mangoman-reel-scripts at their stages. My brief is in {folder}/brief.json: work in that folder and start.

agents.title: Marketing Strategist
agents.summary: A senior strategist for your business: researches the market and competitors, sets positioning, the channel mix and a 90-day plan, then makes the first campaign's ads, emails and posts.
gets: Market, competitor and customer research, with sources
Positioning, messages with proof, SWOT
Channel mix and budget split, a 90-day plan with targets
The first campaign: ads, emails and posts
A designed strategy report (web page and PDF)
needs: Your business, once (kept for every agent)
Your goal and budget, if any

brief.label: What do you most want in the next 90 days?
brief.hint: For example: 200 new customers for our home cleaning service in Pune; launch our app in two cities

brief.label: Marketing budget, if any (with currency, per month or in total)
brief.hint: Leave empty if there is none yet

brief.label: The offer or product to push first
brief.hint: What it is, the price, any dates

brief.label: Anything else the strategist should know
brief.hint: What worked or failed before, limits, people, partners

agents.prompt: Be my Marketing Strategist. Use the mangoman-marketing-strategist skill, with mangoman-market-research, mangoman-brand-strategy, mangoman-content-strategy, mangoman-copywriting, mangoman-strategy-report, and mangoman-ad-copy, mangoman-email-campaign and mangoman-social-posts for the campaign. My brief is in {folder}/brief.json: work in that folder and start.

agents.title: SEO Strategist
agents.summary: A search specialist for your website: audits it page by page, finds what your customers search for and who ranks, checks local and AI search, plans the fixes and content, then writes the first articles.
gets: A page-by-page audit with fixes in priority order
What customers search for and who ranks today, with sources
Local search and AI answer checks
A content plan, and the first articles written
A designed search report (web page and PDF)
needs: Your business, once (kept for every agent)
What you most want to be found for

brief.label: What do you most want to be found for?
brief.hint: Products, services, places: in your customers' words

brief.label: Where are your customers?
brief.hint: Cities or areas you serve, or online across a country

brief.label: Websites that show up instead of you
Do you use Google Search Console?

agents.prompt: Be my SEO Strategist. Use the mangoman-seo-strategist skill, with mangoman-seo-research, mangoman-market-research, mangoman-copywriting, mangoman-strategy-report and mangoman-seo-article at their stages. My brief is in {folder}/brief.json: work in that folder and start.

agents.title: Data Analyst
agents.summary: Give it a spreadsheet. You get a dashboard with checked numbers and a written report of what they mean.
gets: A dashboard that opens in your browser
A report PDF with the key findings
needs: Your data: Excel, CSV or JSON
agents.file_prompt: Be my data analyst. My data is the file "{file}". Work in its folder, "{folder}", and do not ask me for the file. Look at the data first and decide yourself what matters most for this kind of data; ask me at most one short question, only if the data cannot tell you. Use the mangoman-data-dashboard skill to build a dashboard, then the mangoman-client-report skill for a short report of what the numbers mean.
agents.prompt: Be my data analyst. Use the mangoman-data-dashboard skill to build a dashboard from my data, then the mangoman-client-report skill for a report of what the numbers mean. First ask me for the data file and what I want to know.

agents.title: Website Builder
agents.summary: A fast, mobile-first one-page website for your business, or the words for a bigger site.
gets: A one-page website you can open and publish
Or the copy for every page of a bigger site
agents.prompt: Build a website for my business. For one page, use the mangoman-landing-page skill. For several pages, first write them with the mangoman-website-copy skill. First ask me what my business does, who it is for, my contact details and my brand.

agents.title: Online Store Seller
agents.summary: Product listings for Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho and Shopify that follow each marketplace's rules.
gets: Title, bullets, description and search terms per marketplace
Files ready to paste or import
agents.prompt: Write my product listings. Use the mangoman-ecommerce-listing skill. First ask me which marketplaces and the real product details.

agents.title: Sales Assistant
agents.summary: A proposal or quotation for a client, with scope, timeline and GST worked out.
gets: A proposal PDF
An editable Word file
agents.prompt: Help me win a client. Use the mangoman-proposal skill. First ask me about the client, the work, my prices and my timeline.

agents.title: Office Assistant
agents.summary: GST invoices, quotations and clear meeting minutes with actions and owners.
gets: Invoice or quotation PDFs
Meeting minutes
needs: Your GSTIN and the client's details, or your meeting notes
agents.prompt: Be my office assistant. Use the mangoman-invoice skill for invoices and quotations, and the mangoman-meeting-minutes skill for meeting minutes. First ask me which one I need today and the details.

agents.title: Resume and Job Helper
agents.summary: A resume tailored to the job you want, and a matching cover letter.
gets: A resume PDF that applicant tracking systems can read
A cover letter
needs: Your current resume or work history
agents.file_prompt: Help me apply for a job. My current resume is the file "{file}". Work in its folder, "{folder}", and do not ask me for it. Use the mangoman-resume skill for my resume and a matching cover letter. First ask me only for the job I want, or its job description.
agents.prompt: Help me apply for a job. Use the mangoman-resume skill for my resume and a matching cover letter. First ask me for my work history or current resume and the job I want.

agents.title: Pitch and Board Deck
agents.summary: Turns your numbers into a slide deck for investors, a board or a big client.
gets: Slides as PowerPoint, PDF and web
agents.file_prompt: Make a slide deck. My numbers are in the file "{file}". Work in its folder, "{folder}", and do not ask me for the file. Use the mangoman-ceo-deck skill. Ask me first only who the deck is for.
agents.prompt: Make a slide deck. Use the mangoman-ceo-deck skill. First ask me for my numbers and who the deck is for.

agents.title: Brand Starter
agents.summary: Your colours, fonts and logo rules in one guide, so everything you make looks the same.
gets: A brand guide PDF
Colour codes and styles for your website and other MangoMan work
agents.prompt: Make my brand guide. Use the mangoman-brand-kit skill. First ask me about my business, my logo and the look I want.

agents.title: App Builder
agents.summary: A small app that works on phones: a calculator, tracker, booking or order form.
gets: An app file that opens in any browser
Tested in a real browser before you get it
needs: Any rules or rates it must follow
agents.prompt: Build me a small app. Use the mangoman-web-app skill. First ask me what it must do, who will use it and any rules or rates it must follow.
